name: Exponential technology

subjectOf.text: Technology has historically outpaced regulation, and the exponential trends in AI development will continue to widen the mismatch between regulation and AI development.
subjectOf.abstract: Technology has historically outpaced regulation.3 The exponential trends in AI development will continue to exacerbate the mismatch between regulation and AI development.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4796714
scope_conditions: assumes continued exponential improvement in AI capability

subjectOf.text: Legacy ex-ante regulatory attempts fail because they assume a static technological landscape, while AI development is dynamic and requires rules that are adaptable and responsive.
subjectOf.abstract: The exponential pace at which AI technology evolves makes it difficult to establish legacy system ex-post regulations that remain relevant over time. In turn, legacy ex-ante regulatory attempts assume a static technological landscape.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4796714
scope_conditions: applies to legacy ex-ante and ex-post rulemaking
